Is your account setup to connect to gmail using imap or pop3.

IMAP

Has you account successfully signed into gmails server and synchronised. The app downloads gmails imap label / folder list during this process.

A. Check server connection

Navigate to ... 1. Settings > account name > fetching mail > incoming server. 2. Click next

Note any error messages if presented. Complete any sign-in if requested.

B. Refresh the folder list

  1. Press the top left menu button on the message list.
  2. Select your gmail account with folders listed (not unified account).
  3. Tap manage folders (bottom of list).
  4. Tap the three dot menu.
  5. Tap refresh folder list.

Pop3

Pop3 doesn't doesn't have a concept of server side folders. Local folders are not supported by the app, only imap folders.

The error message is 100% displayed when imap is disabled.

I'd toggle imap off and on again, saving after each change. Once you've done this, wait a few minutes before trying to connect your phone. This has resolved the error for me in the past.

It's certainly worthwhile checking your outlook recent activity, and confirming the connection attempts that were made by you. This would help exclude any potential security blocks.
